text:
ada: Morning — can we update the onboarding prioritization matrix for Helios-30B? I think we should increase regression-risk weight and add an 'eval_coverage' column. Quick sync at 11?

mike: +1. Where's the latest sheet/link?

ada: https://redwood.internal/sheets/helios-prio (added a draft). I added columns: perf_score, cost_score, regen_risk, roadmap_align, eval_coverage, quant_safe. Proposed weights: perf=30, cost=25, regen=25, roadmap=10, eval_coverage=10.

clara: Suggest shifting to regen=35, perf=25, cost=20, roadmap=10, eval_cov=10. Regression problems have costed us time in the last cycle.

jin: FYI quick quant results from local bench (8-bit int): shows ~2.1x throughput, p95 latency down ~60ms but quality drop on our truth set. Snip below: 
```
run_id: helios_q8_v1
worker: bench-04
latency_p95_ms: 280 -> 220
throughput_tokens_s: 480 -> 1000
quality_delta_em_eval: -0.18
notes: need better prompt calibration
```

sohn: We should add a gating rule: if quality_delta < -0.05 on core eval, mark quant_safe=false. Also add eval_coverage, i.e., how many customer prompt categories covered.

ada: Agree. I'll add `quant_safe` boolean and `coverage_count` numeric. Also adding a short checklist for bring-up: 1) smoke perf on hosted, 2) quant bench, 3) canary with canary_user_set, 4) regression evals, 5) docs.

mike: Infra note — bench cluster needs a GPU quota bump for parallel runs. I'll open the quota ticket now.

opsbot: deploy-bench: cluster spinup requested by @mike — job 432 queued :gear:

clara: For the weekly model review agenda, propose: a) Helios brief b) quant perf + regressions c) prioritization matrix update & weights d) rollout gating decisions. Keep it to 30 mins.

ada: Perfect. I'll update the sheet with Clara's weights, add Jin's quant results as a linked artifact, and send an invite for 11. If anyone has corner-case evals to add, drop them in the sheet under 'customer_prompts' column. Thanks :rocket:
